name: label-printer
description: Design and print labels from Claude Code. Turns "four labels for the wine bottles with a wine icon" into a finished label: Iconify icon search (filled icons first), fonts by name with automatic download (IBM Plex Sans Bold by default), auto two-line wrap, icon-left/icon-top/QR layouts and saved styles, sized to the loaded media (Brother DK and TZe, NIIMBOT die-cut; live tape detection on bridge and hub printers). Prints through pluggable backends: CUPS, ptouch-print, brother_ql, a USB print bridge (P-touch or niimblue-node for NIIMBOT) or a LAN Print Hub. Printers, styles and templates live in the user's own Label-Templates repo, created from a public template. Also bundles the original P-touch MCP server.
